architecture: A modular JavaScript structure built upon the Three.js WebGL framework. The core game loop, scene management, and rendering logic reside in `game.js`, orchestrating separate modules for player mechanics, enemy AI, level generation, UI, input handling, and asset loading. Performance optimization for mobile (low-poly models, efficient draw calls) is paramount. Service Workers will be utilized for comprehensive offline caching of all game assets.

art_prompts.background: Low-poly sci-fi arena environment, dark metallic walls, glowing grid floor, simple geometric pillars, futuristic atmosphere, for 3D game.
art_prompts.player: Low-poly stylized futuristic pistol, sleek design, metallic grey with subtle blue energy accents, for player weapon model.
art_prompts.enemy: Low-poly stylized robot enemy, cube-shaped body, single glowing red eye, metallic texture, simple arms, for 3D game enemy model.
art_prompts.ui_button: Minimalist sci-fi virtual joystick base, handle, and a separate fire button. Translucent blue glow, sharp edges, white outline, for mobile touch UI.

file_structure.index.html: Main entry point, sets up the canvas and loads necessary scripts.
file_structure.game.js: Contains the core game logic, Three.js scene setup, game loop, and orchestrates other modules (e.g., player, enemy, UI).
file_structure.style.css: Provides styling for the HTML document, canvas, and overlay UI elements.
